_connectors_comment: Read-only sources to ask about. Empty = none. To enable one, move it from _connectors_example into connectors and fill it in.

calendar._comment: Google Calendar > Settings > your calendar > 'Secret address in iCal format'. Paste that URL as ics_url. Read-only; treat the URL like a password.

office._comment: Example remote target (Windows/other Mac). Delete if unused.
